name: Fried crickets
summary: Crickets washed, drained, and fried, then finished with lime, chili, and lemongrass. VietnamNet’s 14 July 2023 article names dế than, dế cơm, and dế lửa, and says the plate shows up at many Kon Tum restaurants.
origin: VietnamNet lists fried crickets among five Kon Tum specialties in its 14 July 2023 article.
taste: VietnamNet prints a strong fried smell, and a bite that is nutty and rich.
howToEat: Catch the crickets, wash them, drain them, and fry them. Add lime, chili fruit, and minced lemongrass. A price, a street, and a season were not printed on that article. Check on arrival.
where: Restaurants in Kon Tum, on VietnamNet. A named street was not printed. Check on arrival.
